notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Just in time for Halloween we have the right update for our Bus Mechanic Simulator!

In the time from 27.10. to 03.11. (every year) you will now also have the matching Halloween decoration in the workshop and there is a very special painting for the solo bus.

We wish you a lot of fun with it and a nice Halloween 2020!
